tagline: Build your lunch, brick by brick.
lede: Stacked is a sandwich counter with two ways to order: pick a signature stack off the menu, or build one yourself from bread up — every ingredient a brick, every stack a little construction project. Sign in with a demo account to save your usual, earn loyalty stamps, and reorder in one tap.
